text: If you’d wanted to do me, I’d already be done. But there ain’t nothing you fear more than a bad headline, is there? You’d rather live in shit than let the world see you work a shovel.

body: Told from the points of view of both the Baltimore homicide and narcotics detectives and their targets, the series captures a universe in which the national war on drugs has become a permanent, self-sustaining bureaucracy, and distinctions between good and evil are routinely obliterated.
